question: Which modern-day Indian state was created on 1 April 1937 as the United Provinces by the Britishers?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Uttar Pradesh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** was created on **1 April 1937** as the United Provinces by the Britishers.
 
• Uttar Pradesh was formerly known as** the United Provinces of Agra and Oudh since 1902 which in 1937 **was shortened to United Province or Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The United Province was later renamed Uttar Pradesh when the Constitution of India came into force on **26th January 1950.**
 
• Uttar Pradesh is also known as The Heartland of India because it lies at the heart position of India and has the largest population among the states of India.
 
• Uttarakhand was carved out of Uttar Pradesh as the** 27th state of India on 9th November 2000 as an outcome of the Uttar Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2000.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Uttar Pradesh (As of 2021):**

 
 
• **Statehood day**: 24 Jan 1950.
 
• **Capital City**: Lucknow.
 
• **Area** : 2,40,928 kmsq.
 
• **Districts: **75.
 
• **Governor:** Anandiben Patel.
 
• **State bird: **Saras Crane.
 
• **State Flower:** Palash.
 
• **State animal: **Barasingha.
 
• **State tree:** Ashoka.
 
• **National Park, Wildlife Sanctuary:** Dudhwa National Park, Kishanpur Wildlife Sanctuary, Katarniaghat Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
• **Important rivers:** Chambal, Betwa, Ghaghara, Son, Ganga, Yamuna.
